description: Shares a library file with a team (by slug or id) or a person in the organization (by email or user id) at read, write or admin access; sharing again changes the access. Needs admin access on the file (its creator, an org admin, or an admin share). Viewers are capped at read whatever the share says. Free. Returns the file's shares. Needs an API key or a connected account.

id.description: The file's id from list_files or save_file.

user.description: A member's email or user id.

name: share_file
title: Share library file
